_paper: Han et al., ACS Nano 2026, PMID 41555650, DOI 10.1021/acsnano.5c19138
_lab: Michael J. Mitchell (UPenn). The extraction brief misattributed this to the Dahlman lab; the folder was corrected to curation/mitchellmj_41555650.

P1_amine_core_pinned_by_the_papers_own_s.what: Each amine core is DERIVED from the SI systematic name, then its formula is tested against the mass and moles the SI prints for that amine. Amine 490's printed mmol (0.0750) gives +0.55%, an outlier; the SI's own epoxide line gives 0.528 mmol at 7.0 equivalents, i.e. a true amine charge of 0.0754 mmol, and the deviation collapses to -0.02%. The equivalents column is a SECOND, independent statement of the same quantity and it is the one that is self-consistent.

P2_epoxide_reagent_MW_from_printed_mass_.what: All 15 epoxide charges reproduce the 2-alkyloxirane molecular weight, confirming the TAIL identity independently of the lipid name.

P3_arms_built_vs_arms_in_IUPAC_name.what: The builder attaches one arm per remaining N-H and COUNTS the result; the IUPAC name's 'tetrakis'/'bis' is transcribed separately and never read by the builder. Agreement is evidence.

P4_block_map_vs_printed_labels.what: The IL column is sparse -- one label per 6-row block, placed wherever the cell's text box sits. The IL for each b-LNP is therefore derived from BLOCK STRUCTURE (15 ILs x 6 formulations, with the greyed-out numbers skipped), and every label pdfplumber did read must land in the block it was assigned to.

P5_design_grid_matches_printed_molar_rat.what: Every block must run (35,2.5)(45,2.5)(55,2.5)(35,5)(45,5)(55,5). This is a 90-row test of the block map AND of the table read: a single mis-assigned b-LNP number breaks the pattern.

P9_effect_of_mask_closing.what: The raw colour mask is occluded by the error-bar STEM, which GraphPad draws down the centre of the bar. EVERY move must be UPWARD: an occlusion can only make a detector under-read, so a single downward move would mean the closing is filling something that is not a bar. The uniform sign is the evidence that this is a fix and not a nudge.

P10_P11_P12_cross_panel._what: SI Fig S1A states '% of total signal = (organ signal)/(total organ signal)*100'. So S1A is a CLOSED-FORM function of S2A. Neither panel was used to calibrate the other; the two were digitised from separate rasters at different dpi with separately sampled colour LUTs.

P10_S1A_percentages_sum_to_100.what: The authors never print this. It is implied by their own definition of the quantity, and it tests the S1A read WITHOUT reference to S2A.

P12_closing_improves_agreement_with_S1A.why_excluded: the raw, un-closed mask REFUSED at least one of that LNP's six organs, so no organ total can be formed for it from the raw read
P12_closing_improves_agreement_with_S1A.what: THE AGREEMENT COUNT MUST MOVE. This is the seed for the mask-closing repair: the un-closed read is the defect, and S1A -- a different raster, different dpi, different colour LUT, different calibration -- is the external judge. If the two columns were equal, the closing would be unproven.

benchmark_tops_the_screen.answer: YES, on absolute delivery. SM-102 (b-LNP 102) is ranked 1st of 8 in ALL SIX organs, including the brain, where it is 2.091x the best novel formulation (b-LNP 70, C12-200).
benchmark_tops_the_screen.but: The paper's claim is about SELECTIVITY, not absolute brain signal. Brain/liver ratio: b-LNP 14 (C14-306) = 0.0271 vs SM-102 = 0.0020, a 13.6x advantage. So the lead wins on the ratio while losing on every raw organ value.
benchmark_tops_the_screen.why_this_matters: CLAUDE.md section 8 has an open decision on whether benchmark-only pairs belong in Stage 5's pooled concordance. This is a case where the universal positive control tops the screen outright in every organ, which is the pattern that can push cross-lab concordance toward +1 for reasons unrelated to transferable SAR.

superset_sweep.LABEL: SUPERSET - NOT an identity match
superset_sweep.why_superset: This SMARTS matches ANY tertiary-amine 2-hydroxyalkyl motif, including lipidoids from unrelated libraries and any lipid that merely happens to carry an N-CH2-CH(OH)-CH2 fragment. It is reported as an upper bound on how much of the corpus is CHEMICALLY NEARBY, and must not be read as overlap.

sibling_same_lab_cross_check.sibling_chemistry: amidine-incorporated degradable lipids; thioether-ester tails (e.g. CCCCCCCCCCNC(=N)CCCSCCC(=O)OCCCCCCCCC)
sibling_same_lab_cross_check.finding: ZERO shared chemistry despite a shared lab, and the two amine catalogues are DIFFERENT AND LOCALLY SCOPED: MW_2024's amines are numbered 1-25 from its own building-block set, while this paper's 200/306/114/490/494 are the Anderson/Akinc lipidoid catalogue shared with KL_2010, KW_2014 and AC_2025. Same lab is not same numbering -- a leading token is not an identity.

seed_summary.rule: A check is credited only when the AGREEMENT COUNT MOVES under the seed, or a clean run exits 0 where the seeded run exits non-zero. One seed (P1) initially exited non-zero from an unrelated TypeError and was briefly credited; 07_seed_checks.py now refuses to credit a seed that did not reach its own metric.
